segments.name: Parking
segments.description: Owns and operates parking facilities and related infrastructure throughout the United States for transient and contract parkers.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, we have presented our results as a single reportable segment: parking.

revenueModel.text: Parkers and operators pay the company fees for access to parking spaces that vary with usage, through managed property revenue and rental income.
revenueModel.evidence: The parking segment derives revenue from managed property revenue and rental income at our parking facilities.
